title: Ivo and the Harvest
author: Vesper Yarrow
blurb: Ulyana Delacroix, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
